welcome.title: 🎯 Welcome to Financial Agent
welcome.firstTime: **You do not need to choose a mode.** The system selects a flow from your question, stock context, and data requirements.
welcome.firstTimeHint: Click the **❓** button in the bottom-left corner for an explanation of automatic routing.
welcome.agentMode: 🤖 **Agent** — Uses market, fundamentals, news, or technical tools when data is required
welcome.assistantMode: 💬 **Assistant** — Answers explanations, summaries, and general discussion directly
welcome.deepMode: 🔬 **Deep Analysis** — Starts multi-agent research for explicit comprehensive, multi-angle, or adversarial requests
welcome.proTip: **Tip:** Select a stock on the right so references such as “this stock” carry the correct context.

help.title: How automatic routing works
help.subtitle: Ask normally; the system chooses the appropriate flow for every message

autoRouting.title: No mode selection or locking required
autoRouting.description: Clear live-data, concept, and deep-research requests use deterministic rules. Ambiguous requests are classified by a lightweight model. The selected flow is shown above the input.

assistant.title: 💬 Assistant
assistant.description: Answers directly without automatically requesting current market data or financial tools.

agent.title: 🤖 Agent
agent.when: Current prices, news, fundamentals, technical analysis
agent.description: Selects financial tools, observes their results, and produces a data-grounded answer.

deep.title: 🔬 Deep Analysis
deep.when: Complete investment research, multiple perspectives, adversarial review
deep.description: Technical, financial, and news specialists research independently before debate and final judgment.

tips.title: Tips
tips.symbol: Select a stock on the right to give phrases such as “this stock” clear context.
tips.quickTools: Quick-analysis buttons still call deterministic APIs directly and bypass automatic routing.
tips.transparency: The selected flow and routing reason appear above the input.
